provenance.r8Revision: 2026-09-16 Fable coordinator review of commit 09aea5de (PR #349), 5-point R8: (1) Tier B (predicate-slot dictionary-form waiver) was over-used in the first draft -- 11 rows (들다, 잘하다, 못하다, 어떻다, 그렇다, 싫다, 괜찮다, 특별하다, 한가하다, 반갑다, 멋있다) had 3 real same-ending clashing Tier A candidates available and were converted; only 6 rows with a genuinely open predicate slot (놀다, 지내다, 울다, 춤추다, 고맙다, 아니다) keep the waiver, per predicateSlotWaiverRows below. (2) 되다: '민호 씨는' -> '저는' (a named topic let '의사가' be misread as an independent subject of the distractor verb, e.g. '민호 씨는 의사가 마시고 싶어요' parsed as 'the doctor wants to drink'; '저는' as 1st-person topic makes that double-subject reading ungrammatical). (3) 들다: '가방을 드세요.' -> '저는 가방을 들어요.' (드세요 is ambiguous with 드시다, the honorific of 먹다/마시다). (4) 말다 DROPPED (65 -> 64 words): its only NIKL grade-1 sense is the bound auxiliary '-지 말다' (prohibitive), outside this batch's 8 permitted endings; the 'roll gimbap' free-verb sense substituted in the first draft is not the graded sense. a1_verbs_daily_3 is now 4 words; no verbs remain for Batch 30 (부사/대명사/의존명사/관형사 only). (5) The first draft's 15 flagged 'residual risk' distractor substitutions were re-judged under Tier A first (not left as an allowlisted risk) -- each is now closed either by an EXCLUDE-set addition (14 rows) or a rewritten sentence frame (고프다: added a '점심을 안 먹어서' reason clause so the homophone 배(stomach/boat/pear) can only parse as stomach and dimension-adjective distractors no longer causally follow). See EXCLUDE in the (uncommitted) generator script's inline comments, mirrored in the review packet, for the closed-risk list.

predicateSlotWaiverRows.vocab_a1_0719: 놀다 -- '크리스티안 씨, 우리 같이 ＿＿＿?' invitation slot: 갈까요/볼까요/먹을까요/잘까요/탈까요/읽을까요 all valid same-ending (-(으)ㄹ까요?) completions; no 3 clean clashing candidates exist. waiver = bare dictionary-form verbs (자다/입다/읽다).
predicateSlotWaiverRows.vocab_a1_0734: 울다 -- '아이가 많이 ＿＿＿.' manner-adverb slot: 자다/오다/웃다(직접 반의어) 등 다수의 아동 행위 동사가 같은 -아/어요 형으로 자연스럽게 성립해 3개를 못 채운다(특히 웃다는 울다의 정반의어라 어떤 서사적 이유를 붙여도 함께 성립하는 경우가 많음, R8 재검토로 확인). waiver = bare dictionary-form verbs (입다/자다/타다).
predicateSlotWaiverRows.vocab_a1_0737: 지내다 -- '요즘 잘 ＿＿＿?' bare minimal-response frame (Fable's own explicit example of an allowed waiver). waiver = bare dictionary-form verbs (가다/보다/팔다).
predicateSlotWaiverRows.vocab_a1_0742: 춤추다 -- '우리는 같이 ＿＿＿.' collective-activity slot, same class as 놀다 (배우다/걸다/기다리다 등 다수의 -아/어요 형 동사가 '우리는 같이' 뒤에서 유효한 문장을 만든다). waiver = bare dictionary-form verbs (읽다/입다/자다).
predicateSlotWaiverRows.vocab_a1_0744: 고맙다 -- '정말 ＿＿＿.' is a maximally open exclamatory frame: '정말 + 어떤 형용사든' 자체로 완전한 감탄문이 되므로(예: 정말 커요/많아요/비싸요 모두 유효), Tier A 후보가 원천적으로 존재하지 않는다. waiver = bare dictionary-form adjectives (작다/많다/무겁다).
predicateSlotWaiverRows.vocab_a1_0759: 아니다 -- '저는 학생이 ＿＿＿.' is a copula-negation predicate unique to 아니다 (X이/가 아니에요) -- no other adjective attaches to '학생이' in this same negation-copula shape, so there is no Tier A same-form pool to draw from at all (same class as Batch 25's PREDICATE_SLOT_WAIVER cloze_a1_0407). waiver = bare dictionary-form adjectives (작다/크다/많다).
